about_blocks.text: At the Our House Addiction program is a residential program. The facility can take up to 70 people at the same time. It is actually an all man treatment center that works in three phases. It is actually a recovery center and has an extensive program to treat the addicts. There are volunteers who help in the facility and help service the patients. The program addresses many facets of the addiction, such as the physical, spiritual and social aspects. The people in the program learn to take responsibility for what they have done and are brought to a point where they don’t need the drugs anymore. Of course, like most of the treatments, the patients get a lot of counselling one on one to help them get through it.
